_about: Machine-readable fragment of the species-sheet schema patch (see species-sheet-schema-patch-cry.md for the full patch, rationale, and application instructions). Merge the 'cry' object into each species record; field semantics are CRY-SYNTH.md's.

identity_note.description: One-line sound identity in SHOW-BIBLE S4 style (e.g. 'Bouncing squeak-cry'). Design intent, written before parameters.

rendered_wav.description: Path of the rendered cry file once CRY SYNTH has run; the EP01 cue sheet already references this home. null until rendered.

status.description: draft = parameters proposed by the lane, owner has not locked; locked = sound identity approved. Pilot six ship as draft.

amp_env.description: Amplitude keyframes [[t, level], ...], t normalised 0..1, level 0..1. Chirps/bounces are written as gaps and pulses here.

base_hz.description: Fundamental pitch of the cry voice in Hz before the pitch envelope. Rough size cue: bigger body, lower base.

crackle.description: Density of tiny noise pops mixed under the voice (0..1). Fire-adjacent species only, sparingly.

echo.description: Whole-cry repeats — the classic differentiator. Use for uncanny/open-space species.

length_s.description: Total cry duration in seconds. Typical range 0.4-1.8.

morph.description: Crossfade from wave_a (start) to wave_b (end) across the cry, 0..1.

noise_mix.description: Breath/noise share of the voice, 0..1. 0 = pure tone; ~0.4+ = whisper-class.

noise_tone.description: Brightness of the noise component, 0 (dark rumble) .. 1 (bright hiss).

pitch_env.description: Pitch keyframes [[t, semitones], ...], t normalised 0..1, semitones relative to base_hz. The species' melodic contour: bounces, falls, chirps are drawn here.

pwm.description: Pulse-width modulation for pulse_pwm: duty sweeps duty_lo..duty_hi at rate_hz. Throaty/reedy voices.

seed.description: PRNG seed for the noise/crackle components so renders are reproducible per species.

tremolo.description: Amplitude wobble: throat pulses (croaks) and shivers.

vibrato.description: Pitch wobble, usually entering after delay_s.

wave_a.description: Primary base waveform family at cry start.

wave_b.description: Secondary base waveform family the cry morphs toward (defaults to wave_a).
